notes: «وابن، رافع قالا حدثنا زيد بن حباب» — «قالا» makes Abu Bakr and Ibn Rafi' co-transmitters of one level; the surface «ابن، رافع» is kept as written.
«ح» splits two routes; «كلاهما عن معاوية بن صالح» writes the tail once, so both routes reach him (rule 3).
«بهذا الإسناد» is the final back_reference of the shared tail: no earlier report is supplied in the context.
